canonical_statement: For every probability measure space, measure-preserving endomorphism T, and real-valued L2 equivalence class f, the Cesaro averages of the Koopman iterates of f converge in L2 norm to the orthogonal projection of f onto the subspace fixed by the Koopman operator.

f is a real-valued L2 equivalence class
conclusion: The Nat-indexed mathlib birkhoffAverage sequence for the Koopman continuous linear operator tends atTop to the orthogonal projection onto LinearMap.eqLocus U 1, in the L2 norm topology.
